articles.title: PREVIEW: Blackhawks Look to Build Momentum Against Jets
Heika’s Take: Stars display serious moxie, rally to beat Avalanche and split back-to-back
Dallas Stars sign forward David Perron to one-year, $850,000 contract
Perron signs one-year contract with Stars, will play 20th NHL season
It’s a process: Stars have plenty to like and tweak through first two weeks

away.summary: The Dallas Stars enter the game with a 3-3-1 record, showing defensive strength (1st in GAA and save percentage) but offensive inconsistencies. They will be without forward David Perron due to visa issues, though he recently signed a one-year contract. The team is seeking to build on their recent shootout win over the Avalanche.

home.summary: The Chicago Blackhawks are 2-5-0 and look to build momentum after a homestand that included wins over the Blues and Penguins. They face injury concerns with Mangiapane and Byram out, while Namestnikov is a game-time decision. Spencer Knight is projected to start in goal, and the team relies on young talent like Connor Bedard and Patrick Kane for offense.
